subject.statement: FTX relaunched its exchange worldwide in 2025, fully licensed in the United States, under founder Sam Bankman-Fried (announcement 2 June 2025).
disambiguators: fully licensed in the United States

summary: FTX ceased operations after its November 2022 bankruptcy; Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted and incarcerated, making a 2025 worldwide relaunch under him impossible. No credible reports of such a relaunch or US licensing exist.
